title: Recording, mixing: Lazy Dynamite, Hi, Hi, Hi by Wings | 1972
content:
Studio Two, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Alan Parsons

Overdubs were added to the Wings song ‘Lazy Dynamite’ on 8 October 1972.

The session began, however, with three stereo mixes created of ‘Hi, Hi, Hi’. Numbered RS6 to RS8, they were, however, deemed unsatisfactory, and the song was set aside for the time being.

‘Lazy Dynamite’ had been recorded on 16 September. On this afternoon more electric guitar, drums, and percussion were overdubbed onto take three, to complete the recording.
